subject: general
question: A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 4 days then, B alone can do 19-times of the same work in ______________(days).
solution:
**Given:**

A and B complete a work in 2 days.

A alone can do it in 4 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate of A = 1 work / 4 days = 1/4 work per day

Work rate of A + B = 1 work / 2 days = 1/2 work per day

Work rate of B = Work rate of (A + B) - Work rate of A
